usage.fit: grid (default) | cover | fixed - the same three for every design
usage.note: Each snippet below draws radius at its own ratio. For another design, put its slug in place of the example and use its defaultAspectRatio (2:3 when it has none). react, vue and svelte are the framework components; element is the <tabbied-pattern> web component from a CDN; html is data attributes plus hydratePatterns(), with no build step; core is createPattern() on any element.
usage.vue:
<script setup>
import { TabbiedPattern } from 'tabbied/vue';
import { radius } from 'tabbied/patterns';
</script>

<template>
  <!-- As wide as its parent, at the 2:3 ratio it was designed at.
       Add max-width to bound it, or swap aspect-ratio for a fixed height. -->
  <TabbiedPattern
    :pattern="radius"
    aspect-ratio="2 / 3"
  />
</template>
usage.element:
<!-- As wide as its parent, at the 2:3 ratio it was designed at.
     The inline style sizes the box before the script loads, so nothing shifts. -->
<tabbied-pattern
  pattern="radius"
  style="display: block; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; background: #3E8BFF"
></tabbied-pattern>

<!-- Once per page. It loads each design the page names, and only those. -->
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tabbied@0.10.0/dist/element/tabbied-element.js"></script>

designs.name: Abutment
designs.description: An abutment: the mass at the end of the arch that takes the thrust.

designs.name: Alcove
designs.description: The same frame with one side left open.

designs.name: Anabranch
designs.description: Truchet tiles of paired quarter arcs whose turn follows a smooth field, so the arcs run in long parallel channels that split and rejoin like a braided river.

designs.name: Angleoff
designs.description: A single deep cut running most of the way across, leaving a long triangle.

designs.name: Annulus
designs.description: Rings that thicken row by row down the canvas - the same circle, walked through its whole range, bored right through.

designs.name: Apse
designs.description: A rectangular body with a half-round end swelling off it.

designs.name: Aquarelle
designs.description: Two washes of translucent discs laid half a cell apart, each thickening and thinning with its own smooth field, so where they cross they pool into a third tone.

designs.name: Arriccio
designs.description: The rough coat thrown from a corner, its reach stepped rather than smooth.

designs.name: Arris
designs.description: The arris: the sharp edge where two faces meet, taken off with a small chamfer.

designs.name: Axial
designs.description: A single fold about the horizontal, with the shape running off both edges.

designs.name: Bangle
designs.description: The ring is drawn on the corner rather than the center, so only an arc of it lands in the cell.

designs.name: Basse
designs.description: Wide columns rising through counted levels of translucent enamel.

designs.name: Baste
designs.description: Running stitches basted across the cloth - three dashes to a seam, each thread its own color, slanting one way or the other.

designs.name: Batiste
designs.description: Hairlines spaced far apart on an airy ground.

designs.name: Battlement
designs.description: Crenellated battlements marching along the top edge, re-toothing on each seed.

designs.name: Bauhaus
designs.description: Circles, half-rounds, leaves and squares all cut from one border-radius - so every form morphs fluidly into the next on each redraw.

designs.name: Beamspread
designs.description: One wide beam thrown from the middle of an edge, opening to nearly a half-circle.

designs.name: Bench
designs.description: One deep step cut into an otherwise sheer face.

designs.name: Bengaline
designs.description: Two ribbons fading in opposite directions, warp against weft.

designs.name: Bevelset
designs.description: All four corners cut equally: a regular octagon held inside its square.

designs.name: Bias
designs.description: Every square cut corner to corner, the seam flipping with the checker so the field reads as one running diagonal.

designs.name: Bight
designs.description: A slab of shore with one round bay bitten out of its seaward edge.

designs.name: Bilateral
designs.description: The sheet folded down its middle: everything past the centerline is the mirror of what came before it.

designs.name: Birdsmouth
designs.description: A V cut into one edge, deep enough to reach the middle of the cell.

designs.name: Blindfold
designs.description: Half the cells rule across and half rule down, and nothing says which is which.

designs.name: Bloks
designs.description: Rounded blocks in pale tints of one color, each square with a corner or a side rounded off, laid edge to edge so neighbors run together into capsules and arches.

designs.name: Blossom
designs.description: Isosceles right triangles are randomly placed to balance stability with a bit of mystery and interest.

designs.name: Bluff
designs.description: A half-round face standing straight off one side of the cell.

designs.name: Bobbin
designs.description: Thread bobbins pinched at the waist, turning upright or flat on reseed.

designs.name: Bobbinet
designs.description: A net of eyelets - the ground a bobbin lace is worked on.

designs.name: Bokeh
designs.description: Out-of-focus city lights swimming in the dark - discs drift, swell and refocus softly with every redraw.

svgExport.note: The blur is exported as an SVG filter effect. Browsers render it correctly, but some design tools (like Figma or Illustrator) import SVG filters imperfectly.

designs.name: Bothcut
designs.description: Two sectors from opposite corners, only the lens where they cross left.

designs.name: Bothways
designs.description: A field ruled both ways at once, so only the crossings survive.

designs.name: Bowl
designs.description: Half-discs nested like stacked bowls, the cup swinging to a new edge each seed.

designs.name: Bowsprit
designs.description: A spar run out on the diagonal over the hull below.

designs.name: Bracket
designs.description: L-shaped brackets clicking into corners, each elbow re-orienting on reseed.

designs.name: Buttonhole
designs.description: Worked buttonholes cut right through the placket, upright in one column and crosswise in the next.

designs.name: Cairo
designs.description: The Cairo pentagonal tiling: house-shaped pentagons in pairs, each pair turned a right angle from its neighbors, laid with thin grout lines.

designs.name: Caltrop
designs.description: Four-pointed caltrop diamonds biting into a grid, each re-shading on reseed.

designs.name: Capstan
designs.description: Fine concentric beads turned all the way out from the center.

designs.name: Cardiograph
designs.description: Heartbeat traces on pink ECG paper, row after row of sharp spikes and soft bumps running over a grid of small and large squares.

designs.name: Cascade
designs.description: A three-tread staircase cut from every square, the flight turning to face a new quarter each cell.

designs.name: Casing
designs.description: A plain frame of even width around an open middle.

designs.name: Cavetto
designs.description: A hollow quarter-round run along the edge of every block, turning corner by corner.

designs.name: Cendal
designs.description: A sash cut on the bias, fading along its own length.

designs.name: Centroid
designs.description: A plain grid of squares, lit from the middle: only the opacity carries the field.

designs.name: Chain
designs.description: Oval links running edge to edge, each one overlapping its neighbors.

designs.name: Chamfer
designs.description: Squares with one chamfered corner, the bevel rotating to a new edge on reseed.

designs.name: Charcoal
designs.description: Charcoal: broad, blunt strokes that almost close the paper up.

designs.name: Chase
designs.description: A straight channel run right across the cell, ends open.

designs.name: Chip
designs.description: Squares with two opposite corners knocked off, a few left whole - the chamfer turning a quarter at a time.

designs.name: Cinch
designs.description: Twin arcs pinched at the waist into a bowtie of curves, re-tinting on reseed.

designs.name: Circuit
designs.description: Random walls of hairline traces with bright component nodes soldered in between - the board rewires itself on every redraw.

designs.name: Circus Poster
designs.description: A bold harlequin diamond lattice in crimson, gold, cream and teal against deep indigo, built from a single flipped triangle.

designs.name: Cleat
designs.description: Double chevrons stacked like cleats, the brackets re-pointing on reseed.

designs.name: Clipcorner
designs.description: Two opposite corners cut, so the cell reads as a long lozenge.

designs.name: Cobblestone
designs.description: Rounded cobblestones laid in staggered courses, every stone a little different in shape, set and shade.

designs.name: Coil
designs.description: Color-wheel rings with a hollow hub, the coil re-winding to a new angle on each redraw.

designs.name: Combed
designs.description: Fine rules surviving only in a band across the middle.

designs.name: Comet
designs.description: Shooting stars streak in every direction, colored tails fading in behind bright white heads, with tiny stars holding still between them.

designs.name: Concentric Rings
designs.description: Nested rings in a mixed ink palette, sized by index and frozen mid-rotation until hover sets them spinning back into alignment.

designs.name: Confetti Dot Field
designs.description: A scatter of colored rings and dots on charcoal, catching light like a page of confetti under low light.

designs.name: Confetti Triangles
designs.description: Small triangles scattered in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

designs.name: Contour Lines
designs.description: Rings traced like a survey map, alternating between ink colors, spacing held constant for the whole plate.

designs.name: Corduroy
designs.description: Wide ribs with a narrow channel between them - nearly solid, but not quite.

designs.name: Cornerbite
designs.description: Full squares with a quarter-circle bitten out of one corner - a deep bite on most, a shallow nick on the rest, the corner rolling a quarter turn at a time.

designs.name: Corner Bloom
designs.description: A dense mosaic of solid color blocks, dotted stripes and hairline gradients, built from mismatched rectangles stacked corner to corner.

designs.name: Cornerchip
designs.description: Two opposite corners chipped off deeply, so the cell reads as a long lozenge.

designs.name: Cornercut
designs.description: One corner taken off square, and the cut turning round the cell from one to the next.

designs.name: Corner Notch
designs.description: Each cell takes one random diagonal border on a different edge, like a folded paper corner.

designs.name: Cove
designs.description: A deep circular scoop cut out of every block, the cove swapping to the opposite corner on alternate rows.

designs.name: Crazy Paving
designs.description: Crazy paving of broken flagstones: irregular slabs cut every which way, with joints that widen and narrow as they wander.

designs.name: Crease
designs.description: A crease pattern: the mountain and valley lines drawn before anything is folded.

designs.name: Crescendo
designs.description: The classic multiplication-table doodle with the numbers stripped away: tone deepens smoothly with row times column, re-rolling its grid on every redraw.

designs.name: Cross Lattice
designs.description: A fine cross-and-plus lattice in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

designs.name: Cross Stitch
designs.description: Folk embroidery in little X stitches: stepped diamonds meeting tip to tip, a smaller diamond and a star inside each, worked in red and black on linen.

designs.name: Cupola
designs.description: Domed blocks turning to face all four quarters, each one rolled a quarter turn from its neighbor.

designs.name: Curl
designs.description: The classic Truchet curl: two thin arcs per tile joining into meandering loops - inked on nothing at all, ready to lay over anything.

designs.name: Damier
designs.description: A strict checkerboard - filled squares keyed to their neighbors, the open squares holding a single pip so the field still reads when the ground drops away.

designs.name: Dash Field
designs.description: Short double-lined dashes in a mixed ink palette, scattered edge to edge like a loose confetti of line segments.

designs.name: Decay
designs.description: A fall broken by one flat step half way down, so the drop reads in two stages.

designs.name: Diadem
designs.description: Diamonds set with a smaller diamond core, re-jewelling their two tones on reseed.

designs.name: Diagonal Weave
designs.description: A tight diagonal crosshatch of hairline strokes in a mixed ink palette, alternating direction tile by tile.

designs.name: Diamond Confetti
designs.description: Scattered diamonds in a mixed ink palette, overlapping in a loose confetti toss.

designs.name: Diamond Ember
designs.description: Diamond-dot rows in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

designs.name: Dieblock
designs.description: Every corner squared off with a step rather than a straight cut.

designs.name: Dimetric
designs.description: Two of the three axes foreshortened equally, which is what dimetric means.

designs.name: Diminuendo
designs.description: A field of squares fading out row by row on a straight ramp, top to bottom, without a single step out of place.

designs.name: Dimmer
designs.description: A solid ink with a second fading away across it.

designs.name: Dipole
designs.description: Two poles instead of one, and the field between them bending from one to the other.

designs.name: Disque
designs.description: Discs and half discs over a bright grid, with blocks of fine stripes between them, like a stack of record sleeves.

designs.name: Dogtooth
designs.description: Interlocking hound's-tooth notches re-keying their teeth on every redraw.

designs.name: Dotdrift
designs.description: A soft-edged band of stipple running across the cell with clear ground either side.

designs.name: Dotfade
designs.description: Big dots on a wide pitch, falling away on the diagonal.

designs.name: Dotfield
designs.description: A plain even field: the dot half the width of its tile.

designs.name: Dotmatrix
designs.description: A field of squares instead of dots - the same lattice, cut with straight edges.

designs.name: Dotset
designs.description: Nine dots to a cell, each a third of its own tile.

designs.name: Dotwash
designs.description: The field pooled in one corner, thinning as it goes out from it.

designs.name: Doublebar
designs.description: Two parallel bars of equal weight with a wide channel between them.

designs.name: Downpour
designs.description: Rain in thin streaks, each bright at its head and fading up its tail, slanting with the gusts so the shower leans one way and then another.

designs.name: Drift
designs.description: Triangles all leaning the same way within a row and flipping on the next, with the odd contrary tile drifting through.

designs.name: Drift Spiral
designs.description: A spiral of dots drifting outward from a single point, cooling through a mixed cool-tone palette.

designs.name: Drybrush
designs.description: Rules dragged across the cell, thinning as they go until the ground shows through.

designs.name: Drypoint
designs.description: Drypoint: lines that thicken steadily across the plate, the way the needle digs in as it goes.

svgExport.note: The stripe mask can sit up to a pixel away from the on-screen rendering, and its internal coordinates use calc(), which some design tools don't evaluate.

designs.name: Duotone Truchet
designs.description: Smith truchet tiles filled in two tones, so the quarter arcs close into round blobs and winding channels that run unbroken across the sheet.

designs.name: Dustfall
designs.description: A fine field on a close pitch, settling toward one edge.

designs.name: Eclipse Rings
designs.description: Concentric rings in a mixed ink palette repeating outward from an off-center point, like ripples on dark water.

designs.name: Elbow
designs.description: Fat pastel pipe elbows re-plumbing themselves quarter-turn by quarter-turn - the network reroutes on every redraw.

designs.name: Ell
designs.description: L-shaped brackets locking the grid together, each one spinning to a new corner on reseed.

designs.name: Epicentre
designs.description: Discs at their largest in the middle of the sheet and shrinking all the way to the corners.

designs.name: Evolute
designs.description: The evolute of an ellipse: an astroid stretched, so its four cusps stop being square.

designs.name: Eyot
designs.description: A river islet held between two straight banks.

designs.name: Facetgrad
designs.description: Each tile a two-stop diagonal gradient, the facets re-lighting and re-aiming on reseed.

designs.name: Fadedbar
designs.description: A bar cut on the slant, thinning toward one end.

designs.name: Fadedwedge
designs.description: A corner-to-corner triangle, solid at its base and spent by its point.

designs.name: Fadein
designs.description: Nothing for the first half of the cell, then the ink coming up over the second.

designs.name: Falloff
designs.description: The fade runs from one corner to the one opposite.

designs.name: Fanned
designs.description: Two long shapes fanned from a common corner.

designs.name: Fenestrate
designs.description: Windowed: four small openings cut where the panes would be.

designs.name: Flemish Bond
designs.description: A brick wall in Flemish bond, stretchers and dark burnt headers alternating in every course so the headers line up into a diagonal diaper.

designs.name: Float
designs.description: Fine level lines across the whole sheet, with a disc of upright lines set into the middle so it seems to hover over them.

designs.name: Fluting
designs.description: Fluting: concave channels cut into the face, with a fillet between each pair.

designs.name: Flux
designs.description: The same field turned a quarter: every mark lies across the radius instead of along it.

designs.name: Foldback
designs.description: Arcs folded back on themselves at the centerline of the sheet.

designs.name: Foliage
designs.description: Gradient leaf shapes rotate through the grid, with the occasional berry tucked in between.

designs.name: Fractal
designs.description: Self-similar all the way down: the inner grid uses the same open-or-shut rule as the outer one.

svgExport.note: The nested mask is exported as clean vector shapes - the faint seams visible on screen come from browser rasterization and won't appear in the SVG, so it can differ from the screen by a hair.

designs.name: Frieze
designs.description: A running frieze two cells deep: the upper half of the motif in one row, the lower in the next.

designs.name: Frond
designs.description: Single leaves veined down the middle, the blade turning to a new quarter on reseed.

designs.name: Fulcrum
designs.description: Wedges tipping further off the horizontal the further they stand from the balance point.

designs.name: Fustian
designs.description: A dense, hard-wearing rib - more ink than ground.

designs.name: Garret
designs.description: The gable-end wall with one small light under the peak.

designs.name: Gasket
designs.description: A gasket blank: the sealing face with its bore and a ring of bolt holes punched round it.

designs.name: Gesso
designs.description: Six fine levels, close enough to read almost as a smooth ground.

designs.name: Gimbal
designs.description: Two rings on crossed axes, both swung to the cell's own bearing.

designs.name: Giornata
designs.description: A diagonal fall worked in four flat stages - one day's plaster each.

designs.name: Glazing
designs.description: A dot field with a fade laid over it, so the stipple thins out across the cell.

designs.name: Gloaming
designs.description: The ink holds for a moment at one edge and then falls away to nothing across the rest of the cell.

designs.name: Globe
designs.description: Dots squashed into ellipses toward the rim of a great sphere in the middle of the sheet, with small dots scattered round it.

designs.name: Glyph
designs.description: Every tile is a tiny 2x2 pixel glyph - each quadrant rolls ink, paper or a color on its own, spelling out an unreadable alphabet.

svgExport.note: Quadrant edges may anti-alias a hair differently than the on-screen rendering.

designs.name: Gnomonwedge
designs.description: A right triangle filling half the cell, the hypotenuse running corner to corner.

designs.name: Golden Coil
designs.description: A tight coiled spiral in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

designs.name: Gorge
designs.description: A slot with near-vertical walls, cut almost to the floor.

designs.name: Grain
designs.description: Silver film grain breathing in the dark - every cell fades to its own new exposure, slowly, like static settling.

designs.name: Grainfall
designs.description: A fine grain, dense enough to read as a tint where it starts and as specks where it ends.

designs.name: Grainfield
designs.description: Dots dense enough that the ink joins up and the gaps become the drawing.

designs.name: Gravure
designs.description: Photogravure cells: a grid of square wells with the walls left standing between them.

designs.name: Gritfield
designs.description: The finest field in the section - a texture rather than a pattern.

designs.name: Grosgrain
designs.description: A wide ribbon whose ends feather out instead of stopping.

designs.name: Guernsey
designs.description: A sawtooth skyline filled solid to the hem.

designs.name: Guilloche
designs.description: Rings linked into a mesh, every ring passing over one neighbor and under the next, the under strand broken where it crosses, like interlaced chain.

designs.name: Gully
designs.description: A V worn up into the sheet from its lower edge.

designs.name: Gutter
designs.description: Two text columns with a clean gutter between them, the page grid repeated spread after spread.

designs.name: Gyre
designs.description: A slow rotation about the middle of the sheet: every mark tangent to its own circle.

designs.name: Hairpin
designs.description: A hairpin bend - the road doubling back on itself - turning a quarter with every column.

designs.name: Halfmast
designs.description: A vertical cut, and each half masked back to half its height so the two never sit level.

designs.name: Halftone
designs.description: A halftone ramp printed top to bottom - dots grow with each row, and the whole screen shivers as every dot re-jitters per seed.

designs.name: Halving
designs.description: Two opposite notches of the same size, so the cell would key into a copy of itself.

designs.name: Haunch
designs.description: The haunch of an arch: the corner filled with a curve rather than a bracket.

designs.name: Hemp Leaf
designs.description: Fine lines radiating twelve ways from every point of a hexagonal grid, joining into six-pointed stars of slender leaves.

designs.name: Hex Truchet
designs.description: Hexagonal truchet tiles: three arcs in every hexagon, each joining two neighboring sides, so the arcs link into long meandering loops with no ends.

designs.name: Hilbert
designs.description: The Hilbert curve's four orientations, cycling by cell index so the path always joins up.

designs.name: Hit and Miss
designs.description: A honeycomb brick screen: each course laid with open gaps between the bricks, and the course above bridging every gap.

designs.name: Hongrie
designs.description: Point de Hongrie parquet: planks mitered into stacked chevrons, every plank its own shade of oak, honey and walnut.

designs.name: Horizon Bands
designs.description: Three broad color bands stacked like a horizon line, with a small sun that drifts across on its own timer.

designs.name: Hourglass
designs.description: Bowtie hourglasses pinching at the waist, swivelling upright or sideways on each seed.

designs.name: Housing
designs.description: A slot let into one edge and stopped short of the far side.

designs.name: Hurdle
designs.description: Woven hurdle fencing: flat laths lying across the grain on one square and along it on the next.

designs.name: Ice Crack
designs.description: Cracked ice: a crooked web of shards in pale glazes, every shard split once more and the cracks between them left open.

designs.name: Interlock
designs.description: One tile repeated by translation, its sides bent into S curves that deepen and flatten across the sheet, so the checkered tiles hook into each other like a puzzle.

designs.name: Isocube
designs.description: Tumbling blocks: one hexagon per cell shaded as a lit top and two falling sides, stacking into an isometric wall.

designs.name: Isometric Blocks
designs.description: Tumbling isometric cubes in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

designs.name: Isometric Weave
designs.description: A tilted isometric lattice of dashed and dotted outlines in a mixed ink palette, built from one repeating tile viewed at an angle.

designs.name: Isometry
designs.description: The isometric grid: everything skewed thirty degrees, one way or the other.

designs.name: Ivy
designs.description: Quarter-round leaves tiling into winding vines - each leaf swells from a different corner after every redraw.

designs.name: Jerkinhead
designs.description: A gable with its peak clipped back, leaving a short flat instead of a point.

designs.name: Jet Stream
designs.description: Long thin strokes laid end to end along a slow, smooth current, so the sheet reads as a wind map of streaming lines.

designs.name: Jibboom
designs.description: Two spars run out parallel on the same diagonal.

designs.name: Jigsaw
designs.description: Jigsaw puzzle pieces in mixed colors, each edge cut with a round knob that pokes out of one piece and into its neighbor, so the whole sheet fits together.

designs.name: Karst
designs.description: Limestone pavement: solid clints with the grikes weathered clean through between them.

designs.name: Kawung
designs.description: Javanese batik ovals, four to a cell pointing into the corners, each with an oval eye, closing into four-petaled flowers with a seed at every center.

designs.name: Kerf
designs.description: Saw slots cut clean through solid blocks, the kerf biting from the top on one row and the bottom on the next.

designs.name: Kern
designs.description: Two letters tucked into each other's space until the gap between them reads even.

designs.name: Keyway
designs.description: A shaft with its keyway cut: a bore with one square notch broached out of the wall.

designs.name: Kiln Grid
designs.description: Rotated tiles interlocking into a diamond mosaic, hue blending diagonally between two ink colors like a run of kiln-fired clay.

designs.name: Knotwork
designs.description: A plait of diagonal bands passing over and under one another, broken here and there into arcs that turn back, so the strands tie up into knots.

designs.name: Lagoon
designs.description: Thick rings breached on one side, the gap swinging round the rim from cell to cell.

designs.name: Lantern
designs.description: Paper lanterns drifting in the night, each casting its own halo - reseeding floats them to new heights and re-mixes the glow.

svgExport.note: The glow is exported as SVG drop-shadow filters. Browsers render them correctly, but some design tools (like Figma or Illustrator) import SVG filters imperfectly.

designs.name: Larmier
designs.description: A projecting course: a flat band with its underside bevelled back to the wall.

designs.name: Lattice
designs.description: A diamond lattice of crossing diagonals with a colored pip in each lozenge - argyle, re-pipped on reseed.

designs.name: Linocut
designs.description: Linocut gouges: broad chisel strokes with rounded ends.

designs.name: Lintel
designs.description: A post-and-lintel opening cut from every block, the doorways lining up into a colonnaded wall.

designs.name: Lobe
designs.description: Quarter-round leaves curling from one corner, the petal spinning to a new corner each seed.

designs.name: Lobeform
designs.description: Three corners rounded and one left square: the plainest leaf there is.

designs.name: Loophole
designs.description: Squared rings with rounded inner cut-outs, each frame re-glazing on reseed.

designs.name: Louvre
designs.description: Angled shutter slats set at one constant tilt, so the whole canvas rakes the same way and only the finish changes. The gaps between slats are open, not painted.

designs.name: Lucarne
designs.description: A long roof slope with a small dormer void cut into it.

designs.name: Lunette
designs.description: Half-round lunette windows, each pair of panes parted by an open glazing bar rather than a painted one.

designs.name: Maelstrom
designs.description: A spiral: the bearing plus a turn that grows with the radius, so the arms wind in.

designs.name: Maline
designs.description: Small dots with feathered edges, soft as pressed net.

designs.name: Marbled Arcs
designs.description: Concentric arcs in a mixed ink palette swept together into a single marbled curve.

designs.name: Matryoshka
designs.description: A doodle inside a doodle: each cell holds a whole second grid, and only some of its cells are open.

designs.name: Maze
designs.description: A nod to the classic 10 PRINT one-liner: diagonal strokes tumble across the grid to form an endless maze, with the occasional junction dot.

designs.name: Meetpart
designs.description: Two sectors from opposite corners, only the diamond where they meet left.

designs.name: Mercerising
designs.description: Dots given a luster band on the bias.

designs.name: Meridian Hatch
designs.description: A radiating sunburst disc, hatch angle drifting and ink color drawn from a small curated set.

designs.name: Merlon
designs.description: Squared U-notches like castle merlons, each turning to a new wall on reseed.

designs.name: Metro
designs.description: Quarter-circle arcs meet at the cell edges to sketch a tangled transit map of neon lines and stations on a navy night.

designs.name: Midnight Blossoms
designs.description: Small four-petal blossoms scattered in a mixed ink palette.

designs.name: Midnight Confetti
designs.description: A field of jewel-toned confetti shapes scattered across a near-black ground, softening on every refresh.

designs.name: Milky Way
designs.description: A hazy band of starlight lies across the sheet from corner to corner, crowded with bright four-point glints that dwindle to specks away from it.

designs.name: Mirrorblack
designs.description: Two fans facing each other from opposite edges, almost meeting.

designs.name: Misprint
designs.description: Two riso plates sliding in and out of register - mirrored offsets pull the inks apart and let them overlap into new blends.

svgExport.note: The overlapping inks use a blend mode. Browsers render it correctly, but some design tools import SVG blend modes imperfectly.

designs.name: Mitre
designs.description: A single deep cut running most of the way across, leaving a broad triangle.

designs.name: Miura
designs.description: The Miura fold: a tessellation of parallelograms that opens and closes in one pull.

designs.name: Mixtape
designs.description: Quarter circles, triangles, dots and hatched half discs mixed tile by tile into a dense geometric collage.

designs.name: Modillion
designs.description: A bracket profile: a straight back, a stepped front and an angled underside.

designs.name: Moire
designs.description: Two rulings laid over each other a few degrees apart, so the beat between them draws its own pattern.

designs.name: Moleskin
designs.description: Cloth nearly solid, with only a pinstripe of ground surviving the shear.

designs.name: Monstera
designs.description: Big split monstera leaves, slashed in from the margin almost to the pale midrib, overlapping at angles that sway together across the sheet.

designs.name: Mortise
designs.description: A mortise cut square through each block, standing upright in one column and lying flat in the next.

designs.name: Mullion
designs.description: Tall lights divided by mullions - three panes to an opening, the divisions cut, not drawn.

designs.name: Mutule
designs.description: A block projecting from one edge, wider than it is deep.

designs.name: Neon
designs.description: Glowing tube segments rearranging themselves on a dark wall - each redraw re-aims the lights and re-mixes their halos.

svgExport.note: The tube glow is exported as SVG drop-shadow filters. Browsers render them correctly, but some design tools (like Figma or Illustrator) import SVG filters imperfectly.

designs.name: Ninon
designs.description: Sparse pin dots on a wide open ground.

designs.name: Northern Lights
designs.description: Two curtains of rayed light hang across a night sky in green, teal and violet, brightest along their swaying lower hems and fading upward among faint stars.

designs.name: Northstar
designs.description: Four-point compass stars, each re-inking and the field twinkling on reseed.

designs.name: Nosing
designs.description: One edge stepped forward twice, like the nose of a tread.

designs.name: Notch
designs.description: Square tiles, each with one corner bitten away - bites deepen, shrink and swing around the square with every redraw.

designs.name: Notchblock
designs.description: Big blocks missing a rectangular corner notch, re-orienting on reseed.

designs.name: Notchcut
designs.description: A straight cut with one square notch taken out of the middle of it.

designs.name: Nutation
designs.description: The nod on top of the spin: the bearing with a ripple added to it.

designs.name: Octagon
designs.description: Clean octagons with grouted gaps, each tile re-glazing on reseed.

designs.name: Odessa
designs.description: Capsules and dots stacked down narrow columns, so each column reads as a run of rounded tubes in changing colors.

designs.name: Ogee
designs.description: An ogee lattice - every tile rounded on one pair of opposite corners, flipping with the checker to draw the onion curve.

designs.name: Ortho
designs.description: No perspective at all - the same square everywhere, and only the weight of the line changing.

designs.name: Overbar
designs.description: Two long bars fanned from a common corner, the upper one let down over it.

designs.name: Ovolo
designs.description: Quarter-round moldings turning one corner clockwise per cell, so the field marches through all four faces.

designs.name: Paint Scribble
designs.description: Loose brush-like glyphs in a mixed ink palette, layered with shadow offsets like a quick gestural sketch.

designs.name: Paper Scraps
designs.description: A collage of torn paper scraps laid over one another at angles, each with a ragged white torn edge, some ruled, squared or dotted like pages from a notebook.

designs.name: Paper Sea
designs.description: A sea cut from layers of paper, one wave-edged sheet per row from pale at the top to deep at the bottom, each laid over the one behind with a thin shadow along its edge.

designs.name: Parity
designs.description: A checker that keeps changing its mind: the parity of the column decides the shape, the parity of the row decides the turn.

designs.name: Pattern Sampler
designs.description: A grid of small skewed tile motifs in a mixed duotone ink palette, each cell its own miniature study.

designs.name: Pebble
designs.description: Smooth river stones in tonal greens and blues - circles, drops and leaves that morph from one shape into another on every redraw.

designs.name: Pennantbox
designs.description: Squares with a triangular corner folded down like a turned page, re-folding each seed.

designs.name: Pentomino
designs.description: All twelve pentominoes packed into a rectangle and repeated edge to edge, each piece a solid block of one ink with grout lines between pieces.

designs.name: Peppering
designs.description: Coarse dots concentrated in the middle third and thinning out from there.

designs.name: Percale
designs.description: A crisp, even stripe, ink and ground given equal measure.

designs.name: Perforate
designs.description: A field of small perforations on a square pitch.

designs.name: Petalcut
designs.description: Two opposite corners taken all the way round and two left sharp.

designs.name: Picket
designs.description: A picket fence of vertical pales, the slats fading and re-coloring as the light moves on reseed.

designs.name: Pie Chart
designs.description: A sheet of pie and donut charts, each split into three slices in the same three inks at its own proportions and turned to its own angle.

designs.name: Pindot
designs.description: The smallest dot that still reads, on a close pitch.

designs.name: Pinwheel
designs.description: Discs split into alternating quarter wedges spin at random angles, like a field of paper pinwheels caught mid-turn.

designs.name: Pivot
designs.description: A square field given a twist that accumulates with the radius - flat in the middle, wrung out at the rim.

designs.name: Plait
designs.description: Three strands plaited, the one on top changing every row.

designs.name: Polar Fan
designs.description: Rays and rings thrown out from one corner of the sheet, crossed into a checkerboard that widens as it fans away.

designs.name: Polkadot
designs.description: Big dots on a wide pitch - four or five to a cell and no more.

designs.name: Prisma
designs.description: A full-bleed mosaic of half-square triangles in deep indigo and jewel tones - every reseed melts each facet into its next orientation.

designs.name: Prismfold
designs.description: Folded paper facets catching the light, each panel a soft gradient that re-tilts on reseed.

designs.name: Protractor
designs.description: A half circle with the middle bored out - a sector taken all the way to 180 degrees.

designs.name: Pyramid Relief
designs.description: A triangular grid raised into low pyramids lit from the upper left, each face in one of three tones and every peak nudged a little off center, like chip-carved wood.

designs.name: Quarter Burst
designs.description: A multi-color quarter burst radiating from one corner of each cell in bold, flat bands.

designs.name: Quarter-Circle Quilt
designs.description: Bold quarter-circles and wedges pieced into a rotating patchwork of primary and secondary color.

designs.name: Quarterfall
designs.description: Radius hollowed out: the same rolled quarter-discs, but half of them keep only their outer band, so filled corners and open ones fall through the grid together.

designs.name: Quaver
designs.description: Quarter-disc fills tucked into a rotating corner, the wedge spinning to a new corner each seed.

designs.name: Quilt
designs.description: Half-square triangle patchwork in fabric tones - each block re-cuts its diagonal and trades patches on every redraw.

designs.name: Quire
designs.description: Folded sheets nested inside one another, the way a gathering is made up before it is sewn.

designs.name: Quoinwedge
designs.description: A wedge set into a corner, its point running to the far edge.

designs.name: Quoit
designs.description: Flat throwing rings overlapping in a loose stack, each quoit re-tinting on reseed.

designs.name: Rabbet
designs.description: A block with a step plowed out of one corner, ready to take its neighbor.

designs.name: Racetrack
designs.description: Winding roads made of quarter turns, each a dark band with pale lane lines at its edges and down its middle, looping and meandering across the sheet.

designs.name: Radiance
designs.description: The light comes from one corner of the cell rather than the center of it.

designs.name: Radiant Swirl
designs.description: A swoosh of color swept from the center outward in one continuous radial gesture, built from stacked rotated rings.

designs.name: Radius
designs.description: Quarter circles, half circles and whole discs, one to a cell and turned every way, packed edge to edge so their curves join into arches and petals.

designs.name: Rafter
designs.description: One diagonal member per cell, meeting end to end into unbroken raking stripes.

designs.name: Raking
designs.description: A raking light: parallel bars whose lean builds steadily down the sheet.

designs.name: Raku
designs.description: A scorch reaching in from one corner across most of the cell.

designs.name: Random Rings
designs.description: Irregular overlapping rings in a mixed ink palette, each with a random size and roundness, slowly blurring and scaling up on hover.

designs.name: Rebate
designs.description: The other half of that joint: a block with the notch taken out of its edge.

designs.name: Recession
designs.description: Marks receding into the distance: smaller, fainter and closer together as they go.

designs.name: Reeding
designs.description: Reeding: convex half-rounds run side by side, the opposite of fluting.

designs.name: Reedpen
designs.description: A reed pen: three strokes of the same length, laid down side by side.

designs.name: Regimental
designs.description: Repp stripes raked on the bias, each broad band its own color, with a fine contrasting line running between every pair.

designs.name: Ribline
designs.description: The rules turn a quarter from cell to cell, so the sheet reads as woven rather than lined.

designs.name: Ridgeline
designs.description: One diagonal cut corner to corner, a different ink each side of it, and the ridge turning a quarter at a time.

designs.name: Rimband
designs.description: The ring runs right to the edge of the cell, so it meets its neighbors.

designs.name: Ring
designs.description: A spaced grid of small broken rings, each one printed twice a little off register, like marks from a rubber stamp.

designs.name: Ringfield
designs.description: Rings on a close pitch, run from a point on one edge rather than the center.

designs.name: Ripplering
designs.description: Many fine concentric rings, close enough that the eye reads the spacing before the shape.

designs.name: Rolloff
designs.description: The ramp runs corner to corner rather than edge to edge, so the fall is on the diagonal.

designs.name: Roundcut
designs.description: One corner rounded hard and the other three left square - a quadrant.

designs.name: Roundpair
designs.description: Two opposite corners rounded, which turns the square into a leaf.

designs.name: Roundstep
designs.description: Three corners rounded by different amounts, so the shape leans.

designs.name: Rungs
designs.description: Ladder rungs stacked across the cell, turning upright or flat on each seed.

designs.name: Sail
designs.description: Right-triangle sails with one curved leech, the canvas re-trimming on reseed.

designs.name: Sandfield
designs.description: A fine close field, nearer a texture than a pattern.

designs.name: Scattered Gems
designs.description: A fine scatter of dots in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

designs.name: Scatter Shrink
designs.description: Randomly scattered rings in a mixed ink palette, sized by index and gently pulsing on hover at staggered random delays.

designs.name: Schist
designs.description: Schistosity: parallel planes of mica that split the rock into sheets.

designs.name: Scotia
designs.description: The scotia - a quarter-round hollow scooped out of the block, its arc springing from one corner of the cell and landing on the next.

designs.name: Scramble
designs.description: Each square gives up one of its four quadrants, so the field reads as a wall of L-shapes turning every which way.

designs.name: Scumble
designs.description: Rules that fade as they go, dragged across the cell like a dry brush.

designs.name: Seamband
designs.description: A third ink laid in a narrow band right on the seam, so the join is drawn rather than implied.

designs.name: Selbu Star
designs.description: Knitted eight-petal stars, every petal a slanted block of stitches, with a little cross at each heart and stitch dots where the stars meet.

designs.name: Shading
designs.description: A fade running on the diagonal, over a cell that is otherwise plain.

designs.name: Shatter
designs.description: Mixtape's whole library at once - corner circles, half-square triangles, a centerd disc - and one cell in five raked through with cut slots.

designs.name: Sheared
designs.description: A parallelogram leaning across the cell, with ground either side of it.

designs.name: Shearpair
designs.description: A triangle cut by rules running the other way from its slope.

designs.name: Skewback
designs.description: The cut leans the other way from the corner it starts at, so the profile reads as sprung.

designs.name: Skewblock
designs.description: Parallelograms leaning one way or the other, packing into a field that shears as you read across it.

designs.name: Slashbar
designs.description: One bar leaning at forty-five degrees, kept inside its cell.

designs.name: Slit Lattice
designs.description: A sheet of paper cut with staggered rows of slits and pulled open, the slits gaping into diamonds that are widest round one point and close up to thin slits away from it.

designs.name: Sliver
designs.description: Thin slivers strewn at every angle, re-scattering their spin on reseed.

designs.name: Snipcorner
designs.description: One corner taken off at a shallow angle, so the cut is longer than it is deep.

designs.name: Snub Square
designs.description: The snub square tiling: squares tipped alternately left and right, with pairs of equilateral triangles filling the gaps between them.

designs.name: Soft Bubbles
designs.description: Translucent, overlapping bubbles in a mixed ink palette, softened into a hazy glow.

designs.name: Softedge
designs.description: Solid at one edge of the cell and gone by the other.

designs.name: Sound
designs.description: Two facing shores and the wide water held between them.

designs.name: Spandrel
designs.description: The spandrel - the triangle of wall left over where an arch meets its square frame.

designs.name: Spark
designs.description: Eight-point sparks burning at the center of each cell, re-pointing on reseed.

designs.name: Sparkle
designs.description: Four-point glints - mostly white, some gold or colored - catch the light against the dark, a few collapsing into tiny round twinkles.

designs.name: Speckfield
designs.description: Small dots on a wide pitch, so the cell reads as a tint with texture in it.

designs.name: Spectrum
designs.description: Smooth color wheels turning a quarter at a time, the spectrum sweeping to a new orientation each seed.

designs.name: Spinning Rings
designs.description: Odd and even cells split top and bottom borders into a checkerboard of half-rings, spinning to full rings on hover.

designs.name: Spiralblock
designs.description: A squared-off spiral coiling into each cell, re-winding its tint on reseed.

designs.name: Spiral Rosette
designs.description: Concentric rings stacked and rotated around a single center, tracing a rosette like a plotted spiral.

designs.name: Spit
designs.description: A bar of land curving out from the shore across the water.

designs.name: Spray
designs.description: A wide spray thrown from one edge, the cone opening to nearly a half-circle.

designs.name: Spraydown
designs.description: Nothing at the top of the cell and a heavy spray by the bottom.

designs.name: Square Labyrinth
designs.description: A crisp 3x3 field of nested square spirals traced as a single continuous line, like tiny maze targets stamped edge to edge.

designs.name: Square Tunnel
designs.description: Square frames shrinking toward the middle of the sheet, each turned a little further than the last, so the tunnel twists as it recedes.

designs.name: Staple
designs.description: A staple driven into the board, both legs showing.

designs.name: Stepramp
designs.description: A single fall cut into five flat levels, so the fade is counted rather than smooth.

designs.name: Stipplefade
designs.description: An even stipple at one edge of the cell, thinning to nothing at the other.

designs.name: Stitch
designs.description: Plus signs and crosses stitched into the grid like embroidery, with a few knots scattered through the weave.

designs.name: Strand
designs.description: The beach as a slab against one edge, with a sandbar lying offshore of it.

designs.name: Streaking
designs.description: The rules lean at forty-five degrees and the fall runs square across them.

designs.name: Stylobate
designs.description: Three steps down from one corner to the opposite edge.

designs.name: Subdivide
designs.description: Quartered, then quartered again: a mask that keeps three of every four squares.

designs.name: Subside
designs.description: A band across the middle of the cell, fading along its own length.

designs.name: Subway Tile
designs.description: Glazed subway tiles in running bond, bottle greens and ivories with a gloss along each top edge and a shade along each foot.

designs.name: Sunray
designs.description: A broad sector opening from one corner, so the light comes in across the whole cell.

designs.name: Sunset Rings
designs.description: Rings stack concentrically in a mixed ink palette, alternating direction row by row, like a target seen through haze.

designs.name: Swapcut
designs.description: One diagonal, and the ink either side of it changing places every other cell.

designs.name: Switchback
designs.description: A bold L-turn switchback stroke, the trail doubling back to a new corner each seed.

designs.name: Tailoff
designs.description: A narrow upright, solid at the foot and spent by the head.

designs.name: Taper
designs.description: Squares growing steadily from left to right, each column exactly one step larger than the last.

designs.name: Teal Boomerang
designs.description: Teardrop "boomerang" shapes scattered in a mixed ink palette.

designs.name: Teardrop Leaves
designs.description: A repeating teardrop leaf motif in a mixed ink palette.

designs.name: Terrain
designs.description: A sparse field of small triangles, diamonds, dots and rounded squares in mixed sizes, set in columns between thin vertical rules.

svgExport.note: The drop shadows are exported as SVG filters. Browsers render them correctly, but some design tools (like Figma or Illustrator) import SVG filters imperfectly.

designs.name: Tesserae
designs.description: Hand-set mosaic tiles in three blues, each one cut and laid at its own slight angle so the whole wall shimmers.

designs.name: Tetro
designs.description: T-blocks dropping into place, every tetromino turning to a new orientation each seed.

designs.name: Thickset
designs.description: Heavy throughout, and heavier still as it goes: frames that all but close up.

designs.name: Thirdstop
designs.description: Two cuts rather than one: three bands across the cell, the middle one the odd ink out.

designs.name: Tidering
designs.description: The rings are centerd on the bottom edge, so each cell shows a run of arcs rather than circles.

designs.name: Tidewash Bands
designs.description: Diagonal stripe bands in a mixed ink palette, drifting slowly behind the scene like a tide of color.

designs.name: Tinting
designs.description: A ruled field that fades out as it crosses the cell.

designs.name: Toning
designs.description: Two inks fading past each other in opposite directions.

designs.name: Torsion
designs.description: One square per cell, each turned a fixed fraction further than its neighbor, so the grid twists a full quarter-turn corner to corner.

designs.name: Trigram
designs.description: Sets of three short parallel strokes, one set to a cell, standing upright, lying flat or leaning, like tally marks.

designs.name: Truchet Rings
designs.description: Truchet tiles of paired quarter-circle arcs, rotated at random, tracing interlocking rings across the grid.

designs.name: Tulle
designs.description: An even veil of dots, close enough to read almost as a tint.

designs.name: Turbulent Sunburst
designs.description: A molten, heat-shimmered sunburst of color rays, warped by a turbulence filter and slowly rotating around the plate's center.

designs.name: Twohalf
designs.description: Two blocks with a channel of ground left open between them.

designs.name: Vanishing Point
designs.description: Square towers seen from straight above, their tops leaning out from the middle of the sheet and their walls lit from one side.

designs.name: Veil
designs.description: Squares cut corner to corner into triangles in tints of one hue, the halves meeting their neighbors in zigzags and diamonds.

designs.name: Vichy
designs.description: A two-color gingham: translucent warp and weft checks crossing to a third, deeper shade on a pale ground.

designs.name: Vitrail
designs.description: Stained-glass panes in jewel tones, split by diagonals, arcs and half-moons, with dark leading running between them.

designs.name: Wale
designs.description: Ribbing read end-on: paired ribs with a groove down each pair.

designs.name: Wander
designs.description: The drunkard's path quilt block: quarter-moons in two deep blues wandering over solid ground, joining into snakes and loops.

designs.name: Warp Ribbon
designs.description: A run of threads laid on a sine curve, blending from one ink color to another as the ribbon runs out.

designs.name: Waterbomb
designs.description: The waterbomb base: a square creased on both diagonals and collapsed to a triangle.

designs.name: Wave Fans
designs.description: Fans of concentric rings in rows, each row overlapping the one above so only a scale of every fan shows, like waves on a calm sea.

designs.name: Wavelet
designs.description: Cresting waves curling along the rows, re-tinting on reseed.

designs.name: Weave
designs.description: Stripes alternate between warp and weft from cell to cell, basket-weaving the canvas with the occasional solid patch.

designs.name: Wedge
designs.description: A single wedge cut out of each cell, its angle rolled from a short list.

designs.name: Windowpane
designs.description: A lattice of mullions with the odd crossing node, re-weighting on reseed.

svgExport.note: Cells that mix two border widths on rounded corners can differ from the screen by up to a pixel where the arcs meet.

designs.name: Windrow
designs.description: Tall curved blades of grass two to a cell, rooted along each row and leaning together as gusts move over the field.

designs.name: Woven Khaki
designs.description: A tightly interlaced lattice of concentric rings in warm khaki and ink tones, woven into a dense repeating dot-matrix textile.

designs.name: Yabane
designs.description: Arrow feathers stacked in columns, dark and light by turns like a checker, each chevron split down the shaft in two shades and the columns pointing up and down.

designs.name: Ziggurat
designs.description: Stepped temple silhouettes climbing in four directions - an op-art stairfield, mostly cyan with flashes of other colors.

designs.name: Ziggy
designs.description: Thick chevron bands lock into zigzag ribbons - mostly dark, with colorful chevrons breaking through like radio static turned into fabric.
